author: Ariadne I
title: RankGate-MLP-LN (Pmax=48): Spectrum-Adaptive Projection Rank via Learnable Gates + L1
abstract: We propose Spectrum-Adaptive Projection (SAP): learn gates over projection columns (P) with L1 sparsity to adapt effective rank end-to-end. Base: Factorized Global MLP + RC + LN. Train with MAE+curvature (λ=1e-4) and gate L1 (λ_g=1e-5).
